title: Valuation topology and affine neighbourhood diagrams on birational models
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ a field [def-weil-field], and $\eta:\operatorname{Spec}L\to T$ a morphism [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Use the generic-factorization types of models, quasi-models, model morphisms, and valuation points recorded in [def-trf-riemann-zariski-generic-models], whose defining data make sense for these arbitrary $T,L,\eta$. For a proper model $M$ and an open $W\subseteq M$, define its valuation cylinder to be the valuation points admitting a lift to $M$ respecting $\eta$ whose closed-point image belongs to $W$. The valuation topology is generated by all these cylinders. For a valuation point $v=(V,s)$, an affine valuation neighbourhood consists of a proper model $M$, an affine open $U\subseteq M$, a lift $\operatorname{Spec}V\to U$, and the compatible generic map $\operatorname{Spec}L\to U$. Its coordinate ring is $A=\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$, with the canonical map $A\to V$ induced by the lift and $A\to L$ by composition with $V\subseteq L$. A refinement is a morphism of models restricting to a morphism of the affine opens and respecting the two spectrum maps. For a predicate $P$ on these neighbourhoods, a small affine valuation system consists of a nonempty directed preorder $I$ in the universe of $L$, an admissible family $(U_i)$ cofinal among the $P$-neighbourhoods by these refinements, and refinement maps for $i\le j$. The coordinate-ring pullbacks satisfy identity and composition and commute with the maps to $V$, defining a filtered ring diagram and its canonical cocone into $V$. An affine valuation colimit consists of such a system with injective maps $A_i\to V$ and injective transitions, fraction field $L$ via the canonical map $A_i\to L$, a colimiting canonical cocone, and union $V$. A neighbourhood is above a fixed model $M$ and within an open $W\subseteq M$ if some model morphism to $M$ maps its affine open into $W$.
